title: Development of personalized machine learning models for predicting panic attacks in college students.
summary: In 39 college students with sufficient Oura-ring/survey data, personalized logistic-regression models predicted panic-attack days better than generalized models on identical held-out sprints (PR-AUC lift ratio 1.18, p=0.047); pooled personalized lift was 1.17. This is exploratory, highly selected small-sample evidence.
ai_technology: Personalized logistic regression using wearable and survey data
